from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TARGET = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/runtime_health_publisher.py'


def test_health_publishes_reconciler_summary():
    text = TARGET.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'def reconciler_summary()' in text
    assert '"reconciler": reconciler_summary()' in text
    assert 'RUNTIME / "reconciler.json"' in text


def test_health_reconciler_summary_is_sanitized():
    text = TARGET.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'agent_id' in text
    assert 'task_id' in text
    assert 'decision' in text
    assert 'release_reason' in text
    assert 'password' not in text.lower()
    assert 'token' not in text.lower()
